channel.title: Aaryan Shah, reading list
channel.description: Paper explainers and posts by Aaryan Shah.

item.title: GenRec: An LLM-Backed Recommendation Ranker at Netflix
item.description: Netflix replaces a ranker built on thousands of hand-engineered features with a post-trained in-house LLM that reads watch histories written as text and scores the whole catalog in a single forward pass. Every section, number and figure, with live demos of verbalization, the catalog-aware scoring head, serving cost and the results.

item.title: Attention Is All You Need
item.description: The paper that replaced recurrence with self-attention and became the basis of BERT, GPT and nearly every modern language model. Every section, table and ablation, with live demos of attention, scaling, positional encoding and the learning-rate schedule.
